gaja_kesari_yoga.name: Gajakesari Yoga
gaja_kesari_yoga.rule: Jupiter in a kendra from Moon.
notes: Strength should consider Jupiter dignity, Moon strength, aspects, and affliction.

chandra_mangal_yoga.name: Chandra-Mangal Yoga
chandra_mangal_yoga.rule: Moon and Mars conjoin or mutually oppose.
notes: Result language varies by dignity, house, and benefic/malefic influence.

budhaditya_yoga.name: Budhaditya Yoga
budhaditya_yoga.rule: Sun and Mercury in the same sign.

source_refs.detail: Commonly cited Parashari yoga; exact edition reference pending

notes: Combustion and Mercury dignity should temper strength.

kemadruma_yoga.name: Kemadruma Yoga
kemadruma_yoga.rule: Moon lacks classical support in adjacent signs and kendras from Moon.

source_refs.detail: Kemadruma and cancellation rules vary by edition

notes: Cancellation rules vary; AstroSpace currently uses a conservative simplified flag.

neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga.name: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga
neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga.rule: Debilitated planet receives cancellation through debilitation sign lord or related kendra conditions.

source_refs.detail: Neecha Bhanga conditions; complete exception set pending

notes: Current implementation checks debilitation sign lord in kendra from Lagna or Moon only.

raja_yoga.name: Raja Yoga
notes: Implementation includes conjunction, opposition, parivartana exchange, and special graha drishti for Mars/Jupiter/Saturn; full strength assessment pending.

dhana_yoga.name: Dhana Yoga

source_refs.detail: Dhana yoga combinations; edition references pending

notes: Implementation includes conjunction, opposition, parivartana exchange, and special graha drishti for wealth-house lords; full strength assessment pending.

ruchaka_yoga.name: Ruchaka Yoga
ruchaka_yoga.rule: Mars in own or exaltation sign while in a kendra from Lagna.

source_refs.detail: Pancha Mahapurusha yogas; exact edition reference pending

notes: Strength should consider combustion, aspects, house condition, and divisional support.

bhadra_yoga.name: Bhadra Yoga
bhadra_yoga.rule: Mercury in own or exaltation sign while in a kendra from Lagna.

source_refs.detail: Pancha Mahapurusha yogas; exact edition reference pending

notes: Strength should consider combustion, aspects, house condition, and divisional support.

hamsa_yoga.name: Hamsa Yoga
hamsa_yoga.rule: Jupiter in own or exaltation sign while in a kendra from Lagna.

source_refs.detail: Pancha Mahapurusha yogas; exact edition reference pending

notes: Strength should consider aspects, house condition, and divisional support.

malavya_yoga.name: Malavya Yoga
malavya_yoga.rule: Venus in own or exaltation sign while in a kendra from Lagna.

source_refs.detail: Pancha Mahapurusha yogas; exact edition reference pending

notes: Strength should consider combustion, aspects, house condition, and divisional support.

sasa_yoga.name: Sasa Yoga
sasa_yoga.rule: Saturn in own or exaltation sign while in a kendra from Lagna.

source_refs.detail: Pancha Mahapurusha yogas; exact edition reference pending

notes: Strength should consider retrogression, aspects, house condition, and divisional support.

viparita_raja_yoga.name: Vipareeta Raja Yoga
viparita_raja_yoga.rule: Dusthana lord placed in a dusthana.

source_refs.detail: Dusthana lord reversal combinations; exact verse pending

notes: Strength depends on involved house, dignity, and affliction.

sunapha_yoga.name: Sunapha Yoga
sunapha_yoga.rule: A planet other than Sun, Moon, Rahu, Ketu occupies the 2nd sign from Moon.

source_refs.detail: Chandra yogas; exact edition reference pending

notes: Reported alongside Anapha; subsumed note added when Durudhara is present.

anapha_yoga.name: Anapha Yoga
anapha_yoga.rule: A planet other than Sun, Moon, Rahu, Ketu occupies the 12th sign from Moon.

source_refs.detail: Chandra yogas; exact edition reference pending

notes: Reported alongside Sunapha; subsumed note added when Durudhara is present.

durudhara_yoga.name: Durudhara Yoga
durudhara_yoga.rule: Planets other than Sun, Moon, Rahu, Ketu occupy both the 2nd and 12th signs from Moon.

source_refs.detail: Chandra yogas; exact edition reference pending

notes: When active, Sunapha and Anapha are still reported with a subsumed note.

vesi_yoga.name: Vesi Yoga
vesi_yoga.rule: A planet other than Moon, Rahu, Ketu occupies the 2nd sign from Sun.

source_refs.detail: Surya yogas; exact edition reference pending

notes: Subsumed note added when Ubhayachari is present.

vosi_yoga.name: Vosi Yoga
vosi_yoga.rule: A planet other than Moon, Rahu, Ketu occupies the 12th sign from Sun.

source_refs.detail: Surya yogas; exact edition reference pending

notes: Subsumed note added when Ubhayachari is present.

ubhayachari_yoga.name: Ubhayachari Yoga
ubhayachari_yoga.rule: Planets other than Moon, Rahu, Ketu occupy both the 2nd and 12th signs from Sun.

source_refs.detail: Surya yogas; exact edition reference pending

notes: When active, Vesi and Vosi are still reported with a subsumed note.

adhi_yoga.name: Adhi Yoga
adhi_yoga.rule: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) occupy the 6th, 7th, and 8th signs from Moon.

source_refs.detail: Adhi yoga from Moon; exact edition reference pending

notes: Convention: AstroSpace activates with two of the three houses occupied (moderate) and grades all three as strong; some texts require all three.

amala_yoga.name: Amala Yoga
amala_yoga.rule: A natural benefic (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) occupies the 10th from Lagna or the 10th from Moon.

source_refs.detail: Amala yoga; exact edition reference pending

notes: Anchor (Lagna and/or Moon) is reported in the result notes.

saraswati_yoga.name: Saraswati Yoga
saraswati_yoga.rule: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury each in a kendra, trikona, or the 2nd house from Lagna, with Jupiter in own, exaltation, or a friendly sign.

source_refs.detail: Saraswati yoga; exact edition reference pending

notes: Friendly sign judged by natural friendship of the sign lord toward Jupiter (Sun, Moon, Mars per BPHS ch.3).

shubha_kartari_yoga.name: Shubha Kartari Yoga
shubha_kartari_yoga.rule: Natural benefics occupy both the 12th and 2nd signs from the anchor (Lagna or Moon), with no malefic in either.
notes: Evaluated separately from Lagna and from Moon; each anchor is reported as its own entry.

papa_kartari_yoga.name: Papa Kartari Yoga
papa_kartari_yoga.rule: Natural malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) occupy both the 12th and 2nd signs from the anchor (Lagna or Moon), with no benefic in either.
notes: Evaluated separately from Lagna and from Moon; each anchor is reported as its own entry.

shakata_yoga.name: Shakata Yoga
shakata_yoga.rule: Moon in the 6th, 8th, or 12th from Jupiter; cancelled when Moon is in a kendra from Lagna.

source_refs.detail: Shakata yoga and kendra cancellation; exact edition reference pending

notes: Cancellation reported as inactive with an explanatory note.

guru_chandala_yoga.name: Guru-Chandala Yoga
guru_chandala_yoga.rule: Jupiter conjunct Rahu in the same sign; Jupiter conjunct Ketu reported as a milder variant.

source_refs.detail: Jupiter-Rahu form is the commonly cited definition; Jupiter-Ketu extension is convention-dependent

notes: Jupiter-Ketu same-sign conjunction is reported as a milder variant with a note.

kalasarpa_flag.name: Kalasarpa Flag
kalasarpa_flag.rule: All seven classical planets fall within one side of the Rahu-Ketu axis.

source_refs.detail: Modern/convention-dependent flag; classical source review required

notes: Shown as a flag only, not a deterministic dosha judgement.
